parameters.query:
SELECT mt.id,
       mt.cash_session_id,
       cs.status AS session_status,
       cm.id     AS cash_movement_id
FROM public.miscellaneous_transactions mt
LEFT JOIN public.cash_sessions  cs ON cs.id = mt.cash_session_id
LEFT JOIN public.cash_movements cm ON cm.source_id = mt.id
                                  AND cm.source_type = 'miscellaneous'
WHERE mt.id = $1;

WITH del_mov AS (
    DELETE FROM public.cash_movements
    WHERE source_type = 'miscellaneous' AND source_id = $1
    RETURNING id
)
DELETE FROM public.miscellaneous_transactions
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id;

SELECT
  a.id,
  a.code,
  a.name,
  a.description,
  a.category_type,
  a.is_active,
  a.account_code,
  a.parent_id,
  a.created_at,
  a.updated_at,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM
  miscellaneous_categories a
WHERE
  (COALESCE($1, '') = '' OR
    (
      a.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.description ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.category_type ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.account_code ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.created_at::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.updated_at::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
  )
  AND (COALESCE($4, '') = '' OR a.category_type = $4)
ORDER BY
  a.created_at DESC
LIMIT $2
OFFSET $3;
